In this video we cover:
Tata Motors Demerger Explained: Why It Matters & What the Numbers Say
Tata Motors is officially demerging its commercial vehicle business from its passenger vehicle division. This move, recently approved by shareholders, aims to tackle the company’s ongoing struggles and unlock better value. We’ll explore why Tata Motors is doing this, the history behind it, and what their latest financial results tell us about the road ahead.
